subject.title: gateway: malformed managed image data URLs can stall reply handling

question: Should maintainers land the public gateway ReDoS fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102411 through the normal PR path, or route this issue through security handling first?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and already has a candidate PR, but the affected path is untrusted model-supplied media validation on a stable gateway reply surface, so automation should not choose the disclosure/handling boundary.

options.title: Land after security-aware review
options.body: A gateway/security owner accepts the public handling route and reviews the linked linear-parser PR to closure.

options.title: Route through security handling
options.body: Maintainers pause the public PR path and coordinate this denial-of-service report through the repository security process.

options.title: Keep owner-owned manually
options.body: A gateway owner keeps this issue open while preparing or adapting a manual patch instead of using the current external PR.

recommendation.title: Land after security-aware review
recommendation.body: A gateway/security owner accepts the public handling route and reviews the linked linear-parser PR to closure.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is ownership of the managed outgoing image feature and later hardening in the same module.
